baseline.scope: Tracked source at 2789de6 plus the inherited worker cleanup. Unrelated untracked src/shared-context.ts excluded from validation snapshots.

decision.status: Rejected; no runtime or test changes applied to the repository.
decision.reason: The allocation gains and qualified short-query pressure speedup do not justify recurring possible long-query regressions. Failed controls prevent claiming a confirmed regression, but do not establish a safe tradeoff. The accepted 2789de6 runtime remains in place.

candidate.status: Rejected experimental snapshot; preserved for review.
candidate.change: Keep the original ordinary-path branch intact. After a miss, try a shared matcher accepting $, &, +, comma, semicolon, = and @. Keep URIjs for tilde, encoded paths, dot segments, query/hash delimiters and Windows paths.
candidate.compatibility: The accepted character set has identical Unicode and ISO-8859-1 URIjs encoding. No public API, hook scheduling, parser or dependency changes.

hookAwaitRemoval.decision: Removing awaits from later hook stages changes existing cancellation and microtask boundaries; rejected before performance measurement.

checks.decision: Rejected: removing these awaits changes cancellation at existing microtask boundaries.

tildeFastPath.decision: The interrupted prototype included tilde, which must become %7E in ISO-8859-1 mode. Excluded from the final candidate; no prototype timings were pooled.

environment.execution: Serial builds, tests, profiling, timing and retention checks using existing dependencies. No GitHub API polling, CI triggering or remote push.

allocation.metric: Sampled cumulative allocation, using 4096-byte inspector sampling including objects collected by minor and major GC. Three rotated baseline/candidate/identical-candidate triplets; descriptive medians, not exact bytes or confidence intervals.
allocation.scope: Engine cases use full resource creation through the link pipeline, 512 items and four batches per profile. MDN replays three saved HTML pages and one extracted stylesheet through the real MDN lifecycle, including acquisition, writes and disposal.
allocation.pressure: Retain up to 2 MiB of real JavaScript arrays. Totals include identical harness churn.
allocation.interpretation: Experimental benefits are specific to paths newly eligible for the helper. The candidate was rejected. No general MDN, ordinary-link, retained-heap, peak-memory or RSS improvement is claimed.

measure-final.sh.source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source /mnt/e/tmp/wse-next-optimization-20261004/guarded-path-pass/env.sh
task_root=/mnt/e/tmp/wse-next-optimization-20261004/guarded-path-pass
export WSE_CANDIDATE=safe-path
export WSE_ENGINE_CASES=links-plain,links-punctuation,links-escaped,query-short,query-long
python3 "$task_root/freeze.py"
for mode in profile timing; do
  for suite in engine mdn; do
    for kind in normal pressure; do
      node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=128 --max-semi-space-size=4 \
        "$task_root/harness/compare-final.mjs" "$suite" "$kind" "$mode" \
        > "$task_root/logs/final-$suite-$kind-$mode.log" 2>&1
    done
  done
done
for kind in normal pressure; do
  for variant in 0 1 2; do
    for key in query-short links-escaped; do
      node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=128 --max-semi-space-size=4 \
        "$task_root/harness/retention.mjs" engine "$variant" "$kind" "$key" \
        > "$task_root/logs/retention-$key-$kind-$variant.json"
    done
    node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=128 --max-semi-space-size=4 \
      "$task_root/harness/retention.mjs" mdn "$variant" "$kind" mdn-local \
      > "$task_root/logs/retention-mdn-$kind-$variant.json"
  done
done
python3 "$task_root/verify.py" > "$task_root/logs/verification.json"
